notes: Gear now shows prefix, suffix and tier for every imported item, like [P5] for tier 5 of 9.
Tiers only show where they're certain, and saved builds get them too.
The module now speaks German too and follows Tavora's language, also while it's open.
Item, gem, skill and class names stay English, and so does guide text.
Export build under ⋯ saves the open build as a file in Downloads/Tavora, guide text included.
Load build file reads it back, here or on another PC.
Update guide now names the right site for PoE Vault guides.
Import build now reads PoE Vault guides: passive trees, gem setups and the guide text.
A tree and a gem setup with the same name become one variant. Others show only in Tree or Skills.
PoE Vault has no gear planner, so gear stays empty and the preview says so.
The module now asks to reach www.poe-vault.com.
Flask and charm details from poe.ninja show real numbers instead of {0} placeholders.
The character preview says "1 selectable setup" for a single setup.
Guide updates match variants by the guide's own ID, so reordered or renamed variants stay put.
The update preview lists new, changed and removed variants. Removing needs Save and remove.
The variant you had open stays open after an update.
The preview shows the importer version and the game patch it supports.
Import notes count what the guide keeps but isn't shown yet, like attribute picks, jewels and soul cores.
Import Mobalytics PoE 2 guide URLs from Add > Import build, starting with Ice Shot Deadeye.
Preview all variants, original guide text and Quest Rewards before saving locally.
Update a saved guide manually or import a separate copy. Failed imports leave saved builds intact.
Attach a planner ZIP, .build, PoB XML or Tavora build when automatic importing is unavailable.
Requires Tavora 0.19.3 for isolated automatic page importing.
Add now comes before the build selector.
Add and panel actions have an icon and short description, with one full-width row per action.
Import build, Import character and Load build file are separate options. Guide URL importing is marked unavailable for now.
Panel links form a vertical list and omit the panel you are already viewing.
Use the visible Add button beside the build selector to load a build or import a character.
Import your PoE 2 character from poe.ninja, a PoB export code or a PoB XML file.
My characters stays separate from guide builds and saves locally for offline use.
Preview before saving, refresh manually or update from a new PoB export. Existing data remains on failed imports.
Keep independent PoB profiles, active weapon set, gem levels/quality and source item details. Comparison comes later.
Requests access only to poe.ninja; requires Tavora 0.18.18.
Item details open beside your mouse over neighbouring panels.
Click to pin one item; Escape closes it. Hovering another item leaves the pin unchanged.
Requires Tavora 0.18.18. Existing build files remain compatible.
